apps.versionDescription: v1.5.28 — Scrolling stays smooth during every kind of playback: the song page no longer rebuilds for the playhead, and the shared phrase player no longer broadcasts a fifty-times-a-second tick that rebuilt the Compose and swara screens. The Raga Browser lists also sit at the standard spacing under the pills.
